comparison.rule: A: the same pair for both cases (the five tied pairs, all valid in P2I-2AD) and the same intrinsic level; B: the LACTATE_COMPATIBLE case pairs, the same intrinsic level; C: the tied pairs, intrinsic per case; D: the LACTATE_COMPATIBLE case pairs, intrinsic per case. Gains and ceilings common in all four; analytic on the same arrival decompositions. A change restores compatibility when its joint count exceeds A's; BOTH_CONTRIBUTE is confirmed when case severity (B) and patient-specific intrinsic (C) each restore it.

equivalence.rule: Each case is filtered at every lactate-side point with P2I-2AD's own series and checks (L1: FD-LAC-02/03, FD-LAC-01, FD-LAC-06; L3: adequacy INADEQUATE / LOST, FD-LAC-04 FAIL, FD-LAC-05 FAIL, FD-LAC-06 active and residual; L2: FD-LAC-06; a stopped or uncontrolled run fails), L1 then L3 then L2, per demand factor. A case-pair candidate (P3 set, crystalloid point, kinetics, excess, 57m pair, 72f pair) survives when both cases pass every unit it projects to. The tied pairs (the same pair for both cases) must reproduce P2I-2AD's committed region exactly at demand 1.0 (its region digest) and its survivor counts at 0.9 and 1.1, else the run stops.

faculty.common: acute and debt gains, the smooth saturation law and the total sinus ceilings 150 / 175 / 200 stay common; pressure stays DEFERRED (diagnostic only); arrival tolerance +-5 bpm
faculty.intrinsic: intrinsic HR is patient-specific: 60 / 80 / 100 per case, candidate uncertainty, never identified or approved, no extra value
faculty.no_hr: the arrival HR (124 / 112) never chooses D0, delivery, a level or a pair; the pairing is frozen before any lactate or HR count
faculty.ordering: the non-HR perfusion phenotype (57m: BP 88/54, lactate 4.4, CRT 5 s, IVC 0.9 cm near-complete collapse, near-obliterated LV, HCO3 17.3; 72f: 98/62, 3.4, 4 s, 1.1 cm > 50 %, hyperdynamic LV, 19.8) makes 57m more severe; the slightly lower Hb of 72f does not reverse it; no exact severity is derived from a single observation
faculty.recertification: D / lactate recertified on the current physiology with P2I-2AD's machinery; D and D -> lactate semantics, FD-LAC constraints, blood / fluid ranges, demand values, rho handling and L3 adequacy unchanged; only the arrival case-pair assignment changes
faculty.scope: shadow only; no HR latent selection, no trajectory envelope, no pressure / RR calibration, collapse, migration or runtime integration
faculty.severity: arrival D0 and arrival delivery are patient-state initial conditions: each case may take its own EXISTING certified arrival pair; no new D0 or delivery value, no interpolation, no case-specific sympathetic gain

hr_surface.rule: Arrival HR is analytic (derived.heart_rate_decomposition at the case's own arrival pair, P2I-2AG's primary profile: pressure 0): 57m intrinsic 60 / 80 / 100 x 72f intrinsic 60 / 80 / 100 x the five common acute gains x the five common debt gains x the common ceilings 150 / 175 / 200, on the LACTATE_COMPATIBLE case pairs only. JOINT when |HR57 - 124| <= 5 and |HR72 - 112| <= 5. No best candidate.

policy: Shadow only. P2I-2AB's current source space and P2I-2AD's machinery (its committed records), never the P2F historical region (P2FGuard); legacy never read (LegacyLock). Existing arrival pairs only, ordered without HR before any count; haemodynamics simulated once, D and lactate post-processed per case (validated, else stop); arrival HR analytic; trajectories post-processed and validated; no Cartesian product with blood, fluid, lactate and HR; nothing selected or approved.
severity_reads: Every (57m pair, 72f pair) of the existing support with the frozen ordinal verdict (no physiology run).
The arrival values of one existing pair for one case, from the case bands only.

trajectories.rule: For each LACTATE_COMPATIBLE case pair with joint arrival survivors: its LOW / MID / HIGH lactate representatives, each case run once by the full core with its own pair (L1, L2 at the representative's crystalloid point, L3), and the primary HR (pressure 0) post-processed for every joint survivor of that pair; distributions (min / median / max) per case over representatives x survivors. One survivor per representative and case is re-run by the full core at L3 (exact HR, else the run stops). No envelope filters anything.

validation.rule: P2I-2AC's sample rule on this lactate side (per rate the first, middle and last P3 set; lactate-side indices 0, n/4, n/2, 3n/4, n-1 and the canonical point; L1, L3 and L2 at the first and last crystalloid point; both cases) at reserve 2.5, demand 1.0 and intrinsic midpoint: exact equality of every minute's lactate, D, deficit and actual flow, of haemostasis and stop, and of every verdict (FD-LAC, L3 adequacy, active and residual FD-LAC-06). On the canonical point also demand 0.9 and 1.1 and intrinsic lower / upper (exact), and reserve 2.0, 3.0 and the synthetic reference 1 (within 1e-9, identical verdicts). Any disagreement stops the run.

verdict.rule: HR_NUMERIC_DECISION_SURFACE_READY_FOR_FACULTY when: (1) the arrival severity is case-specific without HR (severity_reads() names no HR quantity) and at least one case pair is admissible; (2) the D / lactate recertification passes: the factorization agrees with the full core, the tied pairs reproduce P2I-2AD exactly, and at least one admissible pair is LACTATE_COMPATIBLE; (3) the intrinsic rate is declared per case (explicit; no fallback); (4) the gains are common (by construction); (5) at least one jointly arrival-compatible candidate exists (else ARRIVAL_HR_MODEL_REMAINS_STRUCTURALLY_UNRESOLVED); (6) the pressure contribution is 0 in the primary profile; (7) no D / lactate / RR regression (tied equivalence, the core unchanged); (8) no structural contradiction (the HR reconstruction equals the full core on the representatives). The suite criterion is the final certification's. Otherwise HR_NUMERIC_DECISION_SURFACE_NOT_READY with the first blocker. Nothing is approved.
